svg.title: Engineering Atlas — 13-Node Systems Map
svg.desc: A systems map showing 13 project nodes organized into four capability categories: Agentic orchestration and human authority, Evidence-led document and decision systems, Domain optimization and applied intelligence, and Full-stack, API, and operational engineering. Each node links to its case directory. Solid lines represent observed relationships; dashed lines represent analytical comparisons.
svg.text: Evidence-first · Source-pinned · Honest status · Not production-ready
Educational & Evaluation Work (outside the 13 project nodes)
reviews/ — authored technical evaluations · courses/ — senior-agentic-systems + understanding-ai-generated-code
projects/ — inherited engineering assets (legacy evidence preserved)
Live public site · no source repo
Nodes 01–13 map to case directories at ./cases/01-ailora/ through ./cases/13-azimi-innovation-lab-website/
Each case has README.md + engineering-evidence.md with EVD- IDs linked in docs/evidence/central-index.md
Observation date: 2026-10-17/18 · Independence: SECOND_AGENT_REVIEW (not independent third-party) · No source repos modified
